title: Storage Charges on Completed and Withdrawn Vehicles — Insurance Claim Repairs
content:
## When storage is charged to the customer

Under Insurance Claim Repairs, storage is charged to the customer when a completed vehicle is not collected in time, and when a withdrawn vehicle is not collected in time after cancellation.

The sentence "The vehicle is still at the center more than the tier's pickup free days after the vehicle-ready date." is **no longer in force** as a clause of this rule; it has been superseded by the current basis and is kept here only as retired text.

## Counting the days

Days are calendar days counted from the vehicle-ready date (or the withdrawal date) as day zero; the first billed day is the day after the last free day. The vehicle-ready date is the completion date on the repair order record.

| Day counted from the vehicle-ready date | Class with 2 pickup free days | Class with 3 pickup free days |
|---|---|---|
| day 0 (vehicle-ready date) | free | free |
| day 1 | free | free |
| day 2 | free (last free day) | free |
| day 3 | first billed day | free (last free day) |
| day 4 | billed | first billed day |

## How the charge is billed

Storage is billed in one storage charge on the collection date, covering the storage period from its first billed day to its last billed day, both included, at the class's daily storage rate: the number of days in the period multiplied by the daily rate.

*Hypothetical:* a storage period running from day 3 to day 6 inclusive is 4 days; at a daily rate of USD 45.00 the charge is USD 180.00.

## Goodwill

The desk may credit storage as goodwill up to the class's goodwill authority per repair order, counting every goodwill credit already made on that repair order; beyond that the request is declined.

*Hypothetical, authority USD 45.00:* with no earlier goodwill credit, a USD 45.00 goodwill credit is within the authority; once USD 45.00 has been credited as goodwill on the repair order, a further goodwill request is beyond it and is declined.

## Total-loss vehicles

Storage on a total-loss vehicle is never charged to the customer; it is billed to the insurer under the total-loss rule.

superseded_clauses: The vehicle is still at the center more than the tier's pickup free days after the vehicle-ready date.
